```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, dplyr, tidyr, knitr, kableExtra, scales)

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
))
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("scenario_evppi_results_", utility_source_label, ".rds"))
preview_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("scenario_evppi_results_", utility_source_label, "_PREVIEW.rds"))
evppi_cache <- if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  readRDS(cache_file)
} else if (file.exists(preview_file)) {
  readRDS(preview_file)
} else {
  NULL
}

evppi_grouped <- data.frame()
if (!is.null(evppi_cache) && nrow(evppi_cache$evppi_all_scenarios) > 0) {
  evppi_all <- evppi_cache$evppi_all_scenarios
  if (!"evppi_population_millions" %in% names(evppi_all)) {
    discounted_pop <- annual_incidence_norway *
      sum(1 / (1 + discount_rate_research)^(0:(research_horizon_years - 1)))
    evppi_all$evppi_population_millions <- evppi_all$evppi * discounted_pop / 1e6
  }

  evppi_grouped <- evppi_all %>%
    mutate(param_group = case_when(
      parameter %in% c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX") ~ "Drug costs",
      parameter %in% c("c_test_NGS", "c_test_CT", "c_test_blood") ~ "Test costs",
      parameter %in% c("c_other_visit", "c_other_baseline",
                       "c_other_follow", "c_other_last") ~ "Other costs",
      parameter %in% c("u_np", "u_p") ~ "Utilities",
      parameter %in% c("p_crp", "p_tmb_braf") ~ "Biomarker prevalence",
      grepl("^b_(crp|tmb_braf)", parameter) ~ "Biomarker-treatment interaction",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*drug", parameter) ~ "Drug costs",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*test", parameter) ~ "Test costs",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*other", parameter) ~ "Other costs",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*util", parameter) ~ "Utilities",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*prevalence", parameter) ~ "Biomarker prevalence",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*interaction", parameter) ~ "Biomarker-treatment interaction",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(param_group)) %>%
    group_by(scenario_name, wtp, param_group) %>%
    summarise(
      EVPPI = sum(evppi, na.rm = TRUE),
      Population_EVPPI_M = sum(evppi_population_millions, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r display-table}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  display_df <- evppi_grouped %>%
    mutate(
      WTP = scales::dollar(wtp, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
      EVPPI = scales::dollar(EVPPI, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 0.01),
      Population_EVPPI_M = paste0("EUR ", sprintf("%.2f", Population_EVPPI_M), "M")
    ) %>%
    select(Scenario = scenario_name, WTP, `Parameter Group` = param_group,
           EVPPI, `Population EVPPI` = Population_EVPPI_M)

  kable(
    display_df,
    caption = "Table S7: EVPPI by parameter group and scenario",
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
    footnote(
      general = paste0("Population scaling: ", annual_incidence_norway,
                       " patients/year over ", research_horizon_years,
                       " years, discounted at ",
                       scales::percent(discount_rate_research, accuracy = 0.1), "."),
      general_title = "Notes: "
    )
} else {
  cat("Scenario EVPPI cache not available. Run scripts/R/analysis/14_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.")
}
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  tables_dir <- here("tables")
  if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  write.csv(evppi_grouped, file = here("tables", "table_s7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

Table S7 has been saved to `tables/table_s7.csv`.
